tool.name: TISSUE
tool.description: predict spatial gene expression with calibrated uncertainty
tool.command: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && export MKL_NUM_THREADS=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && export NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && python '$__tool_directory__/tissue_wrapper.py' --spatial '$spatial' --reference '$reference' #if $targets --targets '$targets' #end if $prediction.normalize_reference --n-folds $prediction.n_folds --n-pv $prediction.n_pv --seed $prediction.seed --graph-method '$graph.method' #if str($graph.method) in ('fixed', 'fixed_radius') --n-neighbors $graph.n_neighbors #end if #if str($graph.method) in ('fixed_radius', 'delaunay_radius', 'radius') and str($graph.radius) not in ('None', '') --radius $graph.radius #end if --gene-groups $calibration.gene_groups --cell-groups $calibration.cell_groups --weight '$calibration.weight' --weight-n-pc $calibration.weight_n_pc --alpha $calibration.alpha $calibration.asymmetric $compute_wasserstein --output '$output' --predictions '$predictions' --lower '$lower' --upper '$upper' --uncertainty '$uncertainty' #if str($compute_wasserstein) == '--compute-wasserstein' --wasserstein '$wasserstein' #end if

param.label: Spatial expression data
param.help: AnnData with cells in rows, genes in columns, expression in X, and coordinates in obsm['spatial'].

param.label: Single-cell RNA-seq reference
param.help: AnnData with expression in X, at least 50 cells, and gene identifiers matching the spatial data.

param.label: Target genes
param.help: One gene per line, without a header. If omitted, predict every reference gene absent from the spatial data. Measured target genes are withheld before training.

param.label: Normalize and log-transform the reference
param.help: Use for raw counts. Disable for a reference already normalized and log-transformed. Spatial expression is used as supplied.

param.label: Cross-validation folds
param.help: Cannot exceed the number of shared genes remaining after withholding targets.

param.label: SpaGE principal vectors
param.help: Cannot exceed the shared gene count in the smallest training fold or either cell count.

param.label: Spatial neighbors
param.help: Must be smaller than the number of spatial cells.

param.label: Maximum neighbor distance
param.help: In coordinate units; must be positive. If omitted, use Q3 + 1.5 × IQR of neighbor distances.

param.label: Spatial neighbors
param.help: Must be smaller than the number of spatial cells.

param.label: Maximum neighbor distance
param.help: In coordinate units; must be positive. If omitted, use Q3 + 1.5 × IQR of neighbor distances.

param.label: Maximum neighbor distance
param.help: In coordinate units; must be positive. If omitted, estimate from Delaunay neighbor distances.

param.label: Gene groups
param.help: K-means gene groups. Use 0 to choose automatically from 2–4, or 1 for a single gene group.

param.label: Cell groups within each gene group
param.help: Use 0 to choose automatically from 2–4, or 1 for a single cell group.

param.label: Principal components for cosine weighting
param.help: Use 0 to use all predicted genes directly. Ignored for spatial graph weighting.

param.label: Miscoverage level (alpha)
param.help: Strictly between 0 and 1. Target interval coverage is 1 − alpha; 0.33 gives 67% coverage.

param.label: Use asymmetric prediction intervals
param.help: Calibrate the upper and lower bounds separately.

param.label: Compute Wasserstein support distances
param.help: Compare target-gene variability with its calibration support. Smaller distances indicate better support.

tool.help:
**What it does**
[TISSUE](https://github.com/sunericd/TISSUE) predicts spatial expression of unmeasured genes from a single-cell RNA-seq reference using SpaGE. It cross-validates measured genes, constructs a spatial graph, computes cell-centric variability, and calibrates conformal prediction intervals. This wrapper implements the upstream prediction and calibration pipeline; optional prediction engines and downstream hypothesis testing/PCA are not exposed.
-----
**Inputs**
Supply two AnnData (``h5ad``) datasets with expression in ``X`` and gene identifiers in ``var_names``. The spatial dataset must also contain coordinates in ``obsm['spatial']``. Layers and ``raw`` are not used. Dense and sparse expression matrices are accepted; spatial expression is converted to a dense matrix during calibration, and SpaGE also densifies expression internally.
Gene names are matched in lowercase and must be unique after conversion. Only shared, non-target genes remain in the output expression matrix and serve as calibration genes. Remove constant shared genes before running the tool. The reference needs at least 50 cells. Prepare spatial expression on the desired analysis scale before running; it is not normalized by this tool. Reference normalization applies Scanpy total-count normalization followed by ``log1p``, as in the upstream tutorial. Disable it for an already prepared reference.
Optionally supply a text file containing one target gene per line, with no header. Empty lines and repeated names are ignored. Each target must occur in the reference. Measured targets are removed from spatial expression before prediction, allowing held-out evaluation. Without this file, all reference genes absent from the original spatial dataset are predicted.
-----
**Choosing parameters**
The principal-vector count must fit the number of shared genes in every training fold. For example, 24 shared genes and 10 folds leave at least 21 training genes per fold, allowing 10 principal vectors. The spatial-neighbor count must be smaller than the number of spatial cells. Distances and radii use the units of the supplied coordinates. Self-neighbors are retained for TISSUE calibration.
TISSUE groups genes and then cells by k-means. Set both group counts to 1 for pooled calibration, or use 0 for automatic selection. Automatic grouping requires at least five genes/cells. The random seed controls cross-validation; upstream clustering uses its own fixed seed.
The target coverage is ``1 − alpha``. Symmetric intervals are the default. Calibration groups with too few scores fall back to the pooled calibration set. If there are insufficient calibration scores even after pooling, upstream TISSUE may return missing bounds, represented as ``NA`` in tabular outputs. Prediction bounds are not clipped to zero.
-----
**Outputs**
The annotated spatial AnnData retains cell metadata and stores predictions in ``obsm['spage_predicted_expression']``. Matching ``_uncertainty``, ``_score``, ``_error``, ``_groups``, ``_lo``, and ``_hi`` entries contain calibration results. Cross-validated shared genes and target genes are both included in these matrices. ``uns['conf_genes_used']`` and ``uns['target_genes_used']`` identify the two sets; ``uns['alpha']`` records the miscoverage level.
Four tab-separated tables report target-gene predictions, lower bounds, upper bounds, and cell-centric uncertainty. The first column is ``cell_id`` and subsequent columns are target genes. These tables preserve spatial cell order. An optional fifth table and ``_wasserstein`` matrix report Wasserstein support distances; smaller distances indicate better calibration support.
